name: Hyde Fisher
source:
Hyde isn’t one to talk much, but when he speaks he tends to say what’s on his mind, to the dismay of those around him.

Similar to Rave, he wasn't raised surrounded by infinite luxury like the academy he’s currently in, and he prefers to stick to a simple lifestyle. He’d much rather keep a low-profile and go undetected by the other students.

Magic: Invisibility - Unusual Mage
Occupation: Student
Species: Human
